findings.title: get_monitor_environment_context discards humanized schedule_type
findings.body: In get_monitor_environment_context (lines 159-171), a local `config` variable is created by copying `monitor_environment.monitor.config` and modifying `schedule_type` to its human-readable display value via `get_schedule_type_display()` (lines 160-162). However, the returned dict at line 168 references `monitor_environment.monitor.config` directly, so the humanized schedule_type is never included in the output. The fix is to use the local `config` variable in the returned dict instead of `monitor_environment.monitor.config`. This is a pre-existing bug carried over from mark_failed.py, but since the code is being moved to a new module, it is a good time to fix it. The humanized schedule_type would appear in the monitor context sent with issue occurrences for monitor failures.
